Build is clean now (exit 0). Two real bugs from the bundler bump, buried under the deprecation noise:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but this code still read `options.retries` (undefined), crashing on `.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Added an `undefined` → `false` case.

The remaining ~8 warnings are genuine deprecation noise (Node's `fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, etc.) unrelated to the crash — not addressed since you asked to get the build passing, but worth a follow-up pass if you want those cleaned up too.
